meta.title: Strategy & Execution Clinic
meta.description: The digital home of Strategy & Execution Clinic: professional membership, verified volunteering, and credentials you can check.

home.headline:
We build strategy...
and turn it into measurable impact.
home.lede: A professional ecosystem that unites expertise in strategy, execution, and performance — and turns knowledge, contribution, and volunteering into verified professional impact.
home.whatBody: Strategy & Execution Clinic is a professional ecosystem for people working in strategy, execution, performance, institutional excellence, governance, human capital, and AI.
home.tracksBody: Eight configurable tracks. Membership is attached to tracks by policy, not by hardcoded product enums.
home.membershipBody: Membership is a professional credential, not a decorative badge. Every visible status is backed by an authoritative server record.
home.volunteerSlogan: Your volunteering is not hours only. It is a verified professional impact record.
home.volunteerBody: Hours are never self-approved. Review, impact, and credentials remain in a permanent auditable ledger.
home.impactBody: Unverified metrics are not shown as fact. Impact scores are derived from approved events and can be recalculated.
home.labsBody: Labs and initiatives are part of the professional journey. Registration, attendance, and certificates can be added without rewriting the core.
home.expertsBody: A public directory is opt-in. Privacy is the default. Public verification never exposes email or phone.
home.partnersBody: Institutional membership and strategic partnership are configurable types, never a shortcut to admin power.
home.toolsBody: Assessments, subscriptions, and Clinic AI are future modules behind feature flags. They are not presented as finished work.
home.joinBody: Apply for membership or volunteering. Review is human. The digital credential is issued after approval.
home.phaseNote: This phase ships the engineering foundation and visual identity. Sign-in and review land in the next phase.
home.trustLine: Human-reviewed membership · Never self-approved hours · Verifiable digital credentials
home.tracksBodyNew: Eight tracks spanning the broadest range of institutional disciplines.
home.whatStatement: A professional ecosystem bringing expertise, execution, and contribution into one place.
trackDescriptions: Turn ambition into a clear direction and coherent choices.
Connect priorities to initiatives, ownership, and outcomes.
Measure progress and build performance systems that scale.
Embed quality and continuous institutional improvement.
Lead transformation from intent through adoption and continuity.
Strengthen responsible decisions, resilience, and compliance.
Enable institutional capability, culture, and leadership.
Apply technology to create practical, measurable value.
home.impactLedgerTitle: Every contribution becomes part of demonstrable impact.

membership.title: Membership
membership.headline: Professional membership built on review, trust, and lasting record.
membership.lede: Membership is an authoritative institutional record—not a decorative badge. Applications are reviewed by humans. Digital credentials and cards come later.
membership.meaningBody: Clinic membership recognizes professional standing across strategy, execution, and institutional excellence. Status is issued only after authorized review.
membership.categoriesBody: Types are configurable. Public application eligibility is controlled per type. Invitation-only types cannot be self-applied.
membership.tracksBody: Members may hold multiple tracks. Tracks are assigned during review and remain part of the authoritative membership record.
membership.volunteerBody: Volunteer Member is a first-class membership type. Volunteering workflows and hour ledgers arrive in a later phase—membership comes first.
membership.howStep1: Choose an eligible membership type and professional tracks.
membership.howStep3: Reviewers may request changes, approve, or reject with reasons.
membership.howStep4: Approval creates an authoritative Active Membership record.
